title: Regularity gained by interval smoothing
statement: Let $\eta>0$, let $m\in\mathbb N$, and let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $m$-times continuously differentiable. Then $S_\eta\psi$ is $(m+1)$-times continuously differentiable on $\mathbb R$.
replaced: For $\eta>0$ and a real function $\psi$, write $S_\eta\psi(x)=\eta^{-1}\int_0^\eta\psi(x+t)\,dt$. For each integer $m\ge0$, if $\psi$ is $C^m$ on $\mathbb R$, then $S_\eta\psi$ is $C^{m+1}$ on $\mathbb R$.
